To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the centralized controller is able to achieve the best performance, the distributed controller has the highest computation time and the decentralized controller has the best performance-computation time trade-off.

the centralized nonlinear MPC controller has better performance than the decentralized one, but with the highest computation time, while the distributed one has the lowest computational time, but with a performance between the centralized and decentralized ones.
the centralized nonlinear MPC has the highest tracking accuracy while the decentralized nonlinear MPC has the lowest computation cost.

the design, implementation, and comparison of centralized, decentralized, and distributed nonlinear model-predictive controllers for a tractor-trailers system.
nonlinear model predictive controller design for a tractor trailer system and the comparison between centralized, decentralized and distributive nonlinear model predictive controller.
the design of centralized, decentralized and a distributed nonlinear model predictive controller.

the distributed nonlinear model predictive controller can be used as a good alternative for a tractor-trailers system, which can achieve good performance while keeping the computation time low.

the centralized controller is the best choice in the sense that it has the best performance and the distributed one is the worst choice in the sense of computation time, while the decentralized controller is the best in the sense of its computation time and the worst in the sense of performance.

the decentralized nonlinear model predictive controller can be a suitable alternative for the centralized nonlinear model-predictive controller in real time control of the tractor-trailer system with a low computation time.
